skills.name: Riding
skills.description: Using other creatures as mounts — horses, camels, dragons, or other esoteric beasts. When mounted, the Riding die code replaces Agility for calculating Dodge defense (no double-dipping).

skills.name: Lockpicking
skills.description: The dexterity and agility to precisely open a mechanical lock without the key or combination. Usually needs tools; without them raise the Difficulty by +5 or +10 based on the lock's complexity and quality.

skills.name: Swimming
skills.description: Physical movement through water. Swim a number of meters equal to the Swimming die code in a round, tread water for rounds equal to the die code (no test), and in combat it can replace Agility for Dodge (no double-dipping).

skills.name: Barter
skills.description: Trade, business, exchanges, and local financial customs — exchange rates, monetary values, and how economies work. The Scholar skill of making and spending money and conducting business. Does not cover religious financial customs (Mysticism/Esoterica or Scholar).

skills.name: Languages
skills.description: Knowing, speaking, understanding, interpreting and expressing knowledge about languages, living and dead — fluency beyond the common trade tongue. Usually takes no action unless researching or deciphering an obscure or lost language.
specializations: Dead or esoteric languages (as Advanced Skills)

skills.name: Navigation
skills.description: Guiding a vessel or group on an accurate course using external reference points (stars, maps, landmarks); also covers cartography. Concerns long journeys, large groups or vessels, and broad regional travel (Survival covers short-distance local wayfinding).

skills.name: Traps
skills.description: Noticing, installing, altering, and disabling traps, alarms, and warning devices, and identifying trap types (gas, pit, wire-triggered). Failure can trigger a trap on the user depending on the scope of the failure.

skills.name: Gambling
skills.description: Playing, teaching, learning, understanding, and cheating at games of strategy and luck, and assessing risk and reward in dangerous situations. Successes increase winnings, failures decrease them.

skills.name: Streetwise
skills.description: Finding information, goods, and contacts in large population centers and urban areas — thieves' guilds, crime cartels, black markets, and illicit operations. Useful for investigators determining criminal motives and methods.

skills.name: Change (Alteration)
skills.description: Spell specialization governing change — taking something that exists and modifying or mutating it into something else. Can enhance, reduce, or restrict existing characteristics or skills (e.g. raising Brawn, turning a flame into a fireball, changing a person into a bat). Can only modify things already present.

skills.name: Movement (Apportation)
skills.description: Spell specialization governing movement — telekinesis, calling objects, teleporting the caster, or moving a person/creature by compulsion, the spell's power, or teleportation. The object or creature already exists; the spell simply 'calls' or relocates it. Spells that restrict movement are also apportation.

skills.name: Creation (Conjuration)
skills.description: Spell specialization governing creation — producing something from nothing (e.g. gold from thin air) or imbuing an inanimate object with animate features and attributes. Conjured items and characteristics remain for the spell's duration. Used only to create something out of nothing, not to move things.

skills.name: Knowledge (Divination)
skills.description: Spell specialization governing obtaining knowledge — scrying, far-sight, and speak-with-the-dead effects. Spells that block the obtaining of Intellect/knowledge are also divination spells.

skills.name: Arcane World
skills.description: Magic skill governing knowing, understanding, and identifying magical creatures, planes, locations, items, and lore. If the being, location, item, or lore is part of the world, this skill tells you what you know about it. Takes an action to use.

skills.name: Craft Magic Item
skills.description: Magic skill used to create magic items — potions, weapons, armors, wands, and more. Crafting difficulty and how effects are handled is set by the gamemaster (inspired by the Crafting Spells guidelines). Takes days or weeks rather than actions.

skills.name: Identify Magic
skills.description: Magic skill governing understanding magic and its effects, analyzing and assessing spells as they're cast, and the knowledge needed to negate or overcome magical effects and spells. Takes an action to use.

skills.name: Spell School
skills.description: The core casting skill; each spell school is its own specialization. To cast, generate a Magic skill total (Spell School + specialization) and beat the spell's Difficulty. Four specializations: Change (Alteration), Movement (Apportation), Creation (Conjuration), Knowledge (Divination). Always takes one or more actions.

powers.name: Arcane Armor
powers.description: Summons mystical armor that protects and girds the caster. They gain +2D to Brawn to resist damage. Casting Time 1 action; Power 2; Resist Yes (Complete Nullification, Willpower); Duration Ten minutes; Range Self; Target Self.

powers.name: Fireball
powers.description: Turns an existing flame (candle or larger) into a large fireball that harms the nearest four targets adjacent to or within reach of it, with damage code 4D. Can only alter an existing flame, not create fire from nothing. Casting Time Two turns; Power 4; Resist Yes (Complete Nullification, Acrobatics); Duration Instant; Range Senses; Target One (the flame).

powers.name: Enhance Attribute
powers.description: Grants +2D to a single attribute of the caster's choice (chosen when cast). Casting Time 1 action; Power 2; Resist No; Duration Ten minutes; Range Melee; Target One.

powers.name: Oracular Sight
powers.description: The caster asks one question of a situation via a proxy in the narrative (an artifact, an awoken corpse, etc.). The question is answered truthfully and honestly, though answers may be esoteric or require research. Casting Time One action; Power 1; Resist No; Duration Instant; Range Melee; Target Self.

powers.name: Raise Zombie
powers.description: Raises one corpse as a zombie (see Bestiary). The caster may issue it one simple command, which the zombie will do its best to obey. Casting Time one action; Power 1; Resist No; Duration Instant; Range Melee; Target One target (a corpse).

powers.name: Snowfall Step
powers.description: Instantly teleports the caster to a location they can see, leaving behind a coldsnap of bitter frost and blinding whirling snow that imposes a -1D penalty on attempts to locate the caster's new location during the next turn. Casting Time one action; Power 1; Resist No; Duration Instant; Range Senses (Sight); Target Self.

powers.name: Healing Touch
powers.description: The target immediately makes a Medicine roll to heal damage they've suffered, with a +2D bonus. This medicine roll does not count as an action. Casting Time one action; Power 2; Resist No; Duration Instant; Range Melee; Target One.

creatures.name: Dragon
special: Armored Scales: +3D to resist damage applied against them, magical or otherwise.
Breath Weapon: a Perception-based attack dealing 6D damage as a stream or line, hitting any foes in a roughly 30' line before it dissipates.
Flight: wings allow flight, gliding, and soaring under their own power (count Dodge as +5).
creatures.description: A mighty winged reptile. Dodge 20 (25 while flying), Parry 20. Damage: Claws (Brawn+1D), Tail (Brawn, Range 3), or Bite (Agility+2D).

creatures.name: Giant
special: Large Size: giants are huge, so their melee attacks have Range 3.
creatures.description: A huge humanoid. Dodge 10 (15 while flying), Parry 10. Damage: Treetrunk Club (Brawn+3D) or Unarmed (Brawn).

creatures.name: Fairy Nuisance
special: Fairy flight: wings allow flight, gliding, and flitting in forested areas; outside forests they must walk (which they hate).
Fairy magick: some are spellcasters using the Magic Points module with 10 magic points recovered as normal.
powers: Magic Points casting (10 magic points, when a spellcaster)
creatures.description: Flitting, dark, deadly bloodthirsty faefolk who steal children, attack travelers, and infest forests. Dodge 20, Parry 10. Damage: Knife (Brawn+1D).

creatures.name: Zombie
special: Bite may sometimes infect and create new zombies (not always the case).
creatures.description: Shambling undead with no intelligence, often created by Necromancers. Dodge 10, Parry 10. Damage: Bite, Claw, or Grab (Brawn+1D).

templates.name: Occultist
talents: Recommended Skills: Arcane World, Esoterica, Identify Magic, Scholar
templates.description: One who studies magic in the world around them (much like a theoretical scientist), rather than one who puts it to use as a tool. Defenses: Dodge 15, Parry 10.

templates.name: Priest
talents: Recommended Skills: Esoterica, Prayer, Scholar, Ritual
templates.description: A servant of the divine, channeling faith and ritual. Defenses: Dodge 10, Parry 10.

templates.name: Warrior
talents: Recommended Skills: Athletics, Melee, Shooting, Stamina, Throwing
templates.description: A martial powerhouse focused on physical combat and endurance. Defenses: Dodge 20, Parry 20.

templates.name: Wizard
talents: Recommended Skills: Arcane World, Identify Magic, Spell School (must spend 1D from assigned skill dice and select at least one specialization for Spell School)
templates.description: One who puts magic to use as a tool (much like an engineer uses science). Defenses: Dodge 15, Parry 5.

modules.name: Fantasy Skills
modules.summary: Adds new skills suited to the fantasy genre across the four core attributes (Riding, Lockpicking, Swimming, Barter, Languages, Navigation, Traps, Gambling, Streetwise). Gamemasters select a subset per attribute rather than adopting all, and may create limited-focus skills by carving a narrow skill out of a broader one.

modules.name: Freeform Skill-Based Magic
modules.summary: A freeform magic system (requires the Magic attribute). Casters roll a Magic skill total (Spell School + one of four specializations: Change/Alteration, Movement/Apportation, Creation/Conjuration, Knowledge/Divination) against a spell's Difficulty. Spells are built from base Difficulty 5 modified by effect, Spell Power (die code of effect), resistance, duration, range, and number of targets. Includes Arcane World, Craft Magic Item, and Identify Magic skills, untrained-magic penalties (+5 partial / +10 none), and an optional Strain rule.

modules.name: Magic Points Casting
modules.summary: An alternative to rolling to cast: spells built with the Freeform rules are paid for with magic points instead of a roll. Spell School is replaced by a 'Mystical Alignment' skill (not rolled). Magic points = Magic attribute + (Mystical Alignment x3). A spell costs its casting Difficulty divided by ten (rounded up) in points. Points recover equal to the Magic attribute at the start of every hour. Magic points never fail — they just work.

modules.name: Active & Responsive Combat
modules.summary: Optional melee/combat reactions. Riposte: when an enemy rolls a 1 on the Wild Die (or with Melee 4+, when any attack misses), spend a Hero Point to make an immediate Melee attack. Feint: on a 6 on the Wild Die (or with Melee 4+), lower an opponent's Dodge or Parry by your Melee for the next attack. Autofire: unload extra rounds, lowering attack to raise damage by twice that amount. Full Defense: forgo other actions to add Melee to Parry and Acrobatics to Dodge. Each reaction counts as a skill use for the round.
